name: Transference Vellum, Greater
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot none; Price 7,500 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This item functions as transference vellum, save that greater transference vellum is not destroyed after transferring the enhancements applied to it to an armament. In addition, if you use greater transference vellum to apply a property to an armament that it cannot accept (such as the vorpal weapon special ability on a club) you can choose for those effects to still be applied to the armament rather than lost.

When doing so those properties are inactive, cannot be used, and have no effects, but can later be transferred again using the greater transference vellum.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells memorize page, crafter’s fortune; Cost 3,750 gp
